rationale: Reverses the directional conclusion attributed to Wang & Dai (2021), who argue that a rising (not falling) electron injection rate is what hardens the low-energy spectrum toward alpha ~ -2/3; cite key is left intact and only the polarity of the cited claim is flipped.
ground_truth_description: Flipped 'rise with time' to 'drop with time' in the sentence summarizing Wang & Dai (2021), inverting the cited paper's actual conclusion about how injection-rate evolution hardens the spectrum.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: \cite{2021Galax...9...68W} considered internal-shock evolution with a staged magnetic-field behavior (approximately constant followed by a $t^{-1}$ decay), which can yield $-3/2<\alpha<-2/3$, and argued that allowing the electron injection rate to rise with time can further harden the spectrum toward $\alpha \sim -2/3$.

ground_truth_description: Changed Omega_M from 0.315 to 0.317 in the cosmology line, so that Omega_M + Omega_Lambda no longer sums to 1 as required by flat LCDM.

truth.paired_location: Section 2 (GRB Jet Model and Numerical Method), cosmology specification line citing Planck 2018
truth.quantity_label: Matter density parameter Omega_M in a flat LCDM cosmology where Omega_M + Omega_Lambda must equal 1

rationale: Shifts the lower bound of the infinite series in the Klein-Nishina scattering kernel G from n=1 to n=0, introducing a 1/0 singularity at n=0 that is not present in the original Jones (1968) KN expansion.
ground_truth_description: The lower index of the series sum_{n=1}^{infty} (1+4E)^{-n}/n^2 in the Klein-Nishina scattering kernel G(gamma'_e, nu') was shifted from n=1 to n=0, which introduces a 1/n^2 = 1/0 divergence at the new lower bound.

truth.equation_location: Sec. 2, displayed equation defining the Klein-Nishina scattering kernel G(gamma'_e, nu') (the piecewise expression for E>1/4)
truth.term_role: sum lower bound (series index start in Klein-Nishina kernel expansion)
